text:
maria: FYI — customer on Vercel Edge sees streaming responses drop with a 401 mid-stream. Happens ~10% of attempts, always after ~2-5s of chunks. Node server side (non-edge) works fine. Repro steps below, any ideas?

kevin: can you paste the root request id / request headers and SDK version?

maria: request id in logs: abc123-edge, SDK in package.json locked at "redwood-sdk": "^2.1.0" (but yarn.lock shows a resolved 3.0.0 mixed in, see below). Headers: Authorization: Bearer <rotating-token>, x-correlation-id: abc123-edge

maria: repro snippet (TS edge):
```ts
import Redwood from 'redwood-sdk';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
const res = await client.stream.chat.create({ model: 'gpt-open', input: 'hello' });
const reader = res.body.getReader();
while (true) {
  const { done, value } = await reader.read();
  if (done) break;
  console.log(new TextDecoder().decode(value));
}
```

maria: logs: 
[2026-03-15T16:34:23.123Z] INFO stream start req=abc123-edge status=200
[2026-03-15T16:34:25.587Z] ERROR mid-chunk req=abc123-edge status=401 msg="token rotated by auth proxy"

nate: interesting — do you see duplicate chunks after retry or stream truncation? Edge runtimes can behave differently with Web Streams when a client replays.

maria: we see duplicated content in ~30% of repro runs, and in other cases the stream just closes with 401. Node (server) run with same SDK version shows a clean stream or a full retry failure (no partial duplication).

ashley: that mixed lockfile + package.json version jumps a red flag. v2 had a retry wrapper that attempted to re-establish the stream on 401; v3 switched to non-retry for mid-stream auth failures. If the client retries the whole stream while the Edge runtime is still piping, you get chunk duplication or weird locked states.

kevin: can you paste the minimal package.json + yarn.lock snippet? Also did the customer enable token rotation (short-lived tokens) on a proxy?

maria: package.json excerpt:
```
"dependencies": {
  "redwood-sdk": "^2.1.0"
}
```
but yarn.lock resolves redwood-sdk@3.0.0 in node_modules for some transitive dep, so the runtime may be mixing code paths. Token rotation: yes, they rotate every 30s via sidecar.

nate: that explains edge-specifics: Edge isolates modules differently and the polyfilled streams + mixed SDK code paths can cause getReader() to be called on a locked stream. Also if token rotation happens mid-stream and the SDK's retry policy tries to replay, the edge runtime will deliver previously buffered chunks again.

ashley: short-term mitigation: set client config to disable automatic retries for streaming calls (e.g., { retries: 0 } or equivalent). Also ask the customer to test with consistent SDK v3.0.1 (explicit install, no caret) and a non-rotating token to confirm behavior.

kevin: agree. For a repro, can you run two comparators: 1) Edge + v2.1.0 + rotating token, 2) Edge + v3.0.1 + rotating token, 3) Edge + v3.0.1 + static token. Need to observe: mid-stream 401, duplicate chunks, stream closed.

maria: ran quick test:
- Edge + v2.1.0 + rotating: 401 mid-stream + duplicate chunks ✅
- Edge + v3.0.1 + rotating: 401 mid-stream but client does NOT retry => stream closes cleanly, no duplicates ✅
- Node + v2.1.0 + rotating: client retries entire stream (no partial dup) => downstream saw only final output, but extra compute cost ⚠️

maria: attaching small log snippet showing duplicate chunk sequence: 
```
chunk#1: "Hello"
chunk#2: " world"
chunk#3: "!"
--- retry triggered ---
chunk#1: "Hello"
chunk#2: " world"
chunk#3: "!"
```

nate: OK. Root cause appears to be combination of (A) short-lived tokens rotating mid-stream, (B) older SDK retry behavior that attempts full request retry on 401 even for streaming endpoints, and (C) Edge runtime stream semantics leading to duplicate delivery when client-side replays are performed.

kevin: plan: 1) recommend immediate customer mitigation steps (set retries:0 for streaming, lengthen token TTL or pause rotation during stream), 2) DevX patch to make the SDK default to not retry mid-stream 401s and add a config flag to opt-in to safe replay with idempotency markers, 3) infra/edge note to add clearer docs about streaming + rotating auth.

maria: customer escalated to P2, they want a short-term config they can flip now. I'll propose the retries:0 change and ask them to test.

sre-bot: Created INC-2026: "Edge streaming mid-stream 401 + SDK retry => duplicate chunks" (owner=unassigned) :white_check_mark:

kevin: assigning to nate to shepherd SDK patch + doc patch. nate: can you own until we have a release candidate?

nate: I will take it. I'll open a PR to default streaming retries to 0 and add a migration note. ETA EOD tomorrow.

maria: thanks — I'll update the customer with the workaround and link INC-2026. Will follow up with results from their test. :thumbsup:
